plan.assemblyNotes: Ecosystem preclassified parts retain native millimetres and assembly coordinates; rigid X=-sourceX,Y=sourceZ,Z=sourceY. No scale. The original combined STL is retained as source.stl but uses its own older coordinate origin; the classified meshes are authoritative for this assembly. limitations: Ecosystem STL is a simplified simulator assembly, not manufacturer production CAD; source provenance before the Ecosystem publication is unverified.
Measured frame envelope81.842mm differs from official81.5mm. Published model is never rescaled to conceal this deviation.
Four-blade propeller outlines, screw heads and connector inserts are photo-derived visual geometry. Blade pitch, threads, hidden fittings and contact fit are unverified.
Source propeller disks are retained in the combined source STL but omitted from display; official K138 photos show four blades, not three.
Photo colors include lighting and are not calibrated reflectance; PCB stays black under shell appearance presets.
No firmware execution, rotor RPM calibration, flight dynamics or physical hardware validation is established by these visual assets.

Optical PCB outline 12×20 mm and 0.8 mm thickness remain photo estimates; seating uses the unchanged source cradle bars at Z=-7.247989654541016. Package total 6×6×2.28 mm is from the linked PixArt datasheet; body/lens detail and six-way connector geometry are simplified estimates. Visible SMD bodies, exposed lands and six black cable loops are photo-derived separate geometry; exact refdes placement, hidden solder joints and main P4 mechanical location remain unverified.

The optical PCB photo excludes the raised lens, socket, protruding plug and wires. Separate supported surfaces preserve those visible components without claiming PCB layout or a complete manufacturing assembly. UNKNOWN stays on the unobserved inward face and is readable in the declared inspection separation.

Original K138 retains the pinned source 300mAh battery in its native coordinates. Official bottom/side references remove the battery; they establish the optical assembly below the cradle, not the installed pack appearance. The source battery has 0.75 mm separation from the optical board top; its raw 0.05 mm overlap with the inner cradle is inherited and not claimed to be a manufacturing fit.

Six black wires connect estimated main P4 to optical P1 housings. Their electrical relationship is schematic-backed, while the hidden main connector location and final route remain ±3mm estimates. Spatial wire-to-pin mapping is unknown; inspection hides fixed harnesses instead of stretching them.

Tighter measured foreground masks restore only visible carrier PCB islands. Regions occluded in every acquired reference remain black and UNKNOWN; no mirrored, front-side or generated trace texture fills them.
